newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Central Food Laboratory of Sharjah municipality has declared desalinated water from a plant affected by an oil spill earlier this month suitable for domestic use.

- Two garment factories in Sharjah and Fujairah have been blacklisted by the Sri Lankan embassy for various offences including non-payment of salaries, failure to repatriate workers and poor working and living conditions.
- Downstream operations are currently being upgraded at the Jebel Ali Free Zone-based Western Oil Co's waste oil refinery.
- India's Minister of State for Agriculture arrives in Muscat on Thursday to inaugurate a four-day Indian Mango Festival.
- Pakistan has suggested to the UAE the establishment of a joint venture in the agricultural sector.
- Jebel Ali Free Zone exports and re-exports totalled 5.3 billion dirhams ($1.4 billion) in the first half of 1997.
